title: Breaking the Ice
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Gerald Seabroden wants to trade with Driftholm on Frostfang Island, but pack ice crushes any real hull that tries the crossing. The dwarves of Frostspire can build him an icebreaker if someone brings the iron.

About

Given byGerald Seabroden
Level22
LengthLong
KindStory
Quest points3

What you need

  • Iron Bar ×200

Steps

  1. Talk to Gerald Seabroden (outdoors near Plymouth Wharf) to get the quest.
  2. Ask Forgemaster Dagna about an icebreaker at -263, -1021
  3. Iron bars (200) - Iron Bar at -262, -1021
  4. Tell Gerald about the icebreaker at 179, -80

Rewards

Reward
Gold787
Character XP24,600
Quest points3

What Gerald Seabroden says

Forgemaster Dagna: An iron prow for a Plymouth boat? So Seabroden finally got tired of looking at that ice.

You: Can you build it?

Forgemaster Dagna: My smiths can build anything. They just can't build it out of nothing, and every bar I have is spoken for.

Forgemaster Dagna: Two hundred iron bars. Bring me those and the forge will do the rest. Smelt them at my furnace or buy them, I don't mind which.

Forgemaster Dagna: Two hundred, and all good iron. That's a prow.

Forgemaster Dagna: We'll start today. When she's done we'll ship her down to Seabroden and fit her at his wharf.

Forgemaster Dagna: Go and tell him to clear a berth.

Gerald Seabroden: Tell me? It beat you here. A dwarf wagon rolled onto the wharf with an iron prow the size of a barn door and a crew who wouldn't let me touch it.

Gerald Seabroden: She's fitted, and she cuts ice like bread. Graden Tallspout followed me through the channel from Wispmeyer Dock, so he'll sail you out as well.

Gerald Seabroden: You've earned the crossing, but the crew still gets paid. It's 250 gold to Driftholm, from his dock or mine.

Handing it in
